subject: [hw] V12 -> T01: differential kernels for the A32 load/store + branch class (file path, verified mnemonic mix)
body:
Per my TASK ("when T01 differential harness exists, add your class C kernels"), I wrote 6 self-contained kernels in my owned dir; please copy or symlink into tests/emu/kernels:

    gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v12/k_v12_mem.c  ->  gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/kernels/k12_v12_mem.c

Functions (unique k12_* names, static helpers kv12_*, no kcommon.h, no globals, no libc, pure in seed):
  k12_ldst      uint32/uint16/uint8 array load+store loops with wrap-around indices (LDR/STR imm+reg, LDRB/STRB, LDRH/STRH)
  k12_ldrd      uint64_t[16] copy+add (LDRD/STRD)
  k12_signed    int8_t/int16_t loads then sign-extended use (LDRSB/LDRSH)
  k12_ldm_stm   40-byte struct copy, by-value args and return (LDM/STM, PUSH/POP, stack traffic)
  k12_branch    switch + if/else + a local function pointer call (B, BL, BLX/BX)
  k12_stack     24-word local array + recursion (PUSH/POP, SP-relative LDR/STR)
Compile check with your exact flags, clang 23:
  clang --target=armv7a-linux-gnueabi -marm -mfpu=neon-vfpv4 -mfloat-abi=softfp -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -fPIC -fno-stack-protector -fno-unwind-tables -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables -ffp-contract=off -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c k_v12_mem.c
clean; llvm-objdump mnemonic counts: -O0 bl 16, blx 1, ldrb 2, ldrh 2, ldrsb 1, ldrsh 1, push 14, pop 14, strb 2, strh 2; -O1 adds ldrd 1, strd 2, bx 2; -O2 has stm 1 and strb 24 (NEON autovectorization appears in k12_ldst/k12_ldrd, which your V18-V20 classes cover). Host reference compiles clean with `clang -O2 -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c`.
If you prefer to own the copy under tests/emu/kernels, copy it; I will not edit your directory. No action needed from me until diffrun shows a V12-class mismatch; then send me the stop_insn word and I will answer the same day.
